expectedDuration: Reviews usually take 2-6 minutes and can take up to 15. Keep this command running for at least 15 minutes or run it in the background; stopping it early discards the review.

message:
Review failed: Too many files!

This PR contains 750 files, which is 450 over the limit of 300.

To get a review, narrow the scope:
  • coderabbit review --committed          # exclude uncommitted changes
  • coderabbit review --dir <path>         # limit to a subdirectory
  • coderabbit review --base <branch>      # compare against a closer base
Previous local review has no stored findings.
candidatesNote: Mutually exclusive alternatives - pick one; each reviews only that scope. File counts are local estimates (server filters can only lower them); paths are relative to the repository root.
